name: Váralja (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with two horizontal bands of red and yellow at the bottom, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Váralja (a red and green shield with a white flower, a sheaf of grain and mining tools) above a yellow scroll inscribed VÁRALJA.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
